The Terminator (model T-800) vs Data from Star Trek

I say Data would win this handily. He's much faster and much smarter than a T-800. He has been shown to completely disassemble and reassemble complex machines/constructs/computers by hand in mere seconds.

As far as strength Data isn't weak, but I don't think he's as strong as a Terminator. However his speed Prevents the Terminator from really using it's strength to it's advantage.

I'd say Data wins this 9/10.

With weapons, especially universe appropriate weapons, data wins.

Hand to hand is closer. The T-800 has superior durability and arguably superior strength. However data greatly outclasses it in terms of speed and agility. Worth noting that he is very well versed in future technology and is much more likely to be able to deduce what he is up against than the T-800.

The only scenario where I see data losing is a random encounter. Meeting a humanoid robot with no prior information data would be reluctant to use force. The T-800 might be able to catch him off guard and end the fight quickly.
